name: DynamicReportGrid
description: Production-ready server-side paginated data grid with dynamic configuration, SQL template support, and zero client-side data caching for IBM Business Automation Workflow

configOptions.name: columns
configOptions.label: Column Definitions
configOptions.description: Array of column definitions with field names, labels, types, and formatters

configOptions.name: pageSize
configOptions.label: Initial Page Size
configOptions.description: Initial number of rows per page (10, 25, 50, or 100)

configOptions.name: pageSizeOptions
configOptions.label: Page Size Options
configOptions.description: Available page size options for user selection

configOptions.name: defaultSortColumn
configOptions.label: Default Sort Column
configOptions.description: Column field name to sort by default

configOptions.name: defaultSortDirection
configOptions.label: Default Sort Direction
configOptions.description: Default sort direction: ASC or DESC

configOptions.name: size
configOptions.label: Grid Size
configOptions.description: Grid sizing mode: small, medium, or large

configOptions.name: showStatusColumn
configOptions.label: Show Status Column
configOptions.description: Display status indicators with color-coded badges

configOptions.name: statusColumnField
configOptions.label: Status Column Field
configOptions.description: Field name containing status values (success, warning, error, info)

configOptions.name: loadingText
configOptions.label: Loading Text
configOptions.description: Text displayed during data fetch operations

configOptions.name: errorText
configOptions.label: Error Text
configOptions.default: Error loading data. Please try again.

configOptions.name: noDataText
configOptions.label: No Data Text
configOptions.description: Text displayed when no results are found

configOptions.name: autoRefresh
configOptions.label: Auto Refresh on Events
configOptions.description: Automatically trigger data refresh when pagination/sort events fire

businessObjects.name: GridColumn
businessObjects.description: Column definition for dynamic grid configuration

properties.name: field
properties.description: Database column name or field identifier

properties.name: dataType
properties.description: Data type: string, number, date, boolean, currency

properties.name: formatter
properties.description: Formatter function name: date, currency, percentage, custom

businessObjects.name: GridDataResult
businessObjects.description: Server response containing current page data and metadata

properties.name: rows
properties.description: Array of row objects for current page

properties.name: totalRows
properties.description: Total number of rows in complete result set

properties.name: sortDirection
properties.description: Current sort direction: ASC or DESC

properties.name: pageInfo
properties.description: Template for page info display (e.g., 'Page {current} of {total}')

properties.name: rowsPerPage
properties.description: Label for rows per page selector

events.name: fetchData
events.description: Fired when grid needs data - connect to service flow to fetch data

events.name: pageChange
events.description: Fired when user navigates to a different page

events.name: sortChange
events.description: Fired when user changes sort column or direction

events.name: pageSizeChange
events.description: Fired when user changes page size

events.name: dataLoaded
events.description: Fired when data fetch completes successfully
